messages.author: Imre Haviland
messages.text: Grant 8077 was disabled by the EDR quarantine on the 7th — not live. 8060 is owner-held for the substation laptop until the field rota ends; lifting that is Nienke's.

messages.author: Beatriz Soriano
messages.text: Responder 2's Friday PM is the change-freeze review, protected. No out-of-hours blocks pre-approved.

messages.author: Maja Lindqvist
messages.text: The change window is Wednesday the 17th. I need the review done and evidenced before it.
